verdict.rationale: llama.cpp runs LLMs locally through a CLI, a server, and a built-in web UI, including vision sessions, so users can feed in their own content and get AI-generated output. A hands-on report describes generating keywords, descriptions and location clues from personal trip photos. However, it is a general inference engine, and turning data into insights is user-driven prompting rather than a dedicated feature. Missing for 10: built-in connection to user data sources, structured insight or suggestion features, and documentation of data-analysis workflows inside the product.
